release_notes: Build 150 removes the retired Dashboard, Projects, Production, Media Library and Asset Review shell from the desktop app.
Startup no longer refreshes the retired project and media workspace before the current Factburst interface is shown.
Quiz, Library, publishing, analytics, website administration and Settings continue to use the current Factburst workspace.
The retired workspace hiding shim is no longer needed now that those legacy surfaces are absent from the shell.
